brief.zh: heights 是一排宽 1 格的冷却柱高度，均为非负整数。压模必须是一个完整矩形，横跨一段连续的整柱，顶边不能高于其中任何一柱。返回模具的最大面积。没有可用高度时返回 0。
brief.en: heights gives the nonnegative heights of unit-width cooling columns. Fit one rectangle across consecutive whole columns. Its top cannot rise above any covered column. Return its largest possible area, or 0 if there is no usable height.

label.en: Scan the row and its far edge
Register heights at the current column

label.en: Set up candidate columns and area
